'''Dire Wolves''' are a species of [[wolf]] found in the forest of [[Tirannwn]], near the limestone mine. Their [[bones]] are normal wolf bones and may be used with a [[chisel]] to create [[wolf bone arrowheads]] for use in [[Big Chompy Bird Hunting]]. They can also be found in the [[Chaos Tunnels]]. They drop a variety of charms, although green charms are the most common.

==Trivia==
* Their examine text is a reference to the fairy tale {{Wp|Little Red Riding Hood}}.
* The Dire Wolf is a reference to {{Wp|Dire wolf|an extinct animal of the same name}}.
* Dire Wolves are associated with [[Seren]], not [[Guthix]], like most other species of wolves. In [[Armies of Gielinor]], they are Serenist units.
* Dire Wolves are also featured in the [[Jagex]] iPhone game, ''Undercroft''.
